title: Who May Overrule the Agent? Evidence-Gated Authority in LLM Review Institutions
description_en: arXiv:2611.05390v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent language-model systems often add a reviewer to improve an upstream agent's decision. Yet a reviewer can both repair errors and replace decisions that were already correct. We study this as a problem of institutional jurisdiction: conditional on the same proposal, task information, model, and review output, when is the reviewer authorized to make its recommendation binding? We compare broad override authority with an evidence gate that permits replacement only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a binding-constraint violation and a compliant repair. title: Wanaka Studio
description_en: Make and publish 3D games with the first AI game engine. The first all-in-one, AI-native game engine. An AI agent builds your AAA-style 3D game. You can edit it directly in a synced visual editor. No code. Auto-rigging, multiplayer, and 1-click publish built in. Uses ~80% fewer tokens and generates faster than Claude Opus 5.5 + Unity.

title: Floot Payments
description_en: Take payments in apps you build in ChatGPT and Claude. Floot apps can now take real money. Ask your AI in ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor for "a $9/month plan", "a checkout for this course" or "shipping labels for my orders", and Floot sets it up: subscriptions with a billing page, one-time payments, tickets and deposits, coupons and refunds, plus shipping with live rates, labels and tracking. Runs on Stripe, no API keys or webhooks. Test free in preview, go live when you publish.

title: Prelulu
description_en: Be the main character: chat & video roleplay any story. Immersive stories with AI characters you can text or video roleplay with. It's our first time bringing real-time avatar technology to consumer scale. You can create your own characters with live avatar capability.

title: Glasshand
description_en: Give your agent a real iPhone and Mac. Glasshand gives your AI agents real iPhones and Macs to work on. Connect Claude Code, Codex, or any other agent, and it can rent a device with a single prompt. The hardware sits in our data center, and your agent uses it the way you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for as long as you rent it. When you’re done, we erase your data and factory-reset it.

title: Render Sandboxes
description_en: A computer for every agent. Render Sandboxes give every agent its own isolated Linux computer. Sandboxes starts in under a second and can run any agent or harness, like Claude Code or Codex. Your agent can also run your app with Docker Compose to test its changes. You decide which domains each sandbox can reach. When your agent goes idle, the sandbox suspends and compute charges stop. It wakes with files and memory intact. And you can reliably run thousands at once - all on the same platform as the rest of your app.

title: OpenMail
description_en: Give your AI agents an identity through email. Your agents sign up for tools, receive verification codes and reply to customers, mostly from your Gmail or a shared sending pool where one bad actor gets everyone flagged. OpenMail gives every AI agent its own inbox on your domain with its own sending reputation, for one API call each. Incoming mail reaches your code over webhook or WebSocket, attachments arrive as text, and there's a hosted MCP server and a Hermes plugin. Built and hosted in the EU, free for 3 inboxes.

title: Orphex MCP
description_en: Run your entire digital marketing stack via one unified MCP. Orphex is the unified MCP gateway for digital marketing teams, handling auth and integrations for 65+ platforms, from Google Ads to Shopify, to give your AI true cross-channel context. Move your AI beyond QA: empower it to analyze integrated performance and take every action a human marketer can. Reallocate budgets, pause unprofitable creatives, or adjust products from a single prompt. Every change is logged and protected by safety guardrails. Start free, 30% off the first month.

title: Rerun
description_en: Turn your AI subscriptions into a team of coworkers. Rerun turns your ChatGPT or Claude subscription into a team of AI coworkers. Each one has tools, a computer and a shared workspace, runs on a schedule or a trigger, and asks before risky actions. Now open-source (AGPL v3) and self-hostable.

title: Living Brain
description_en: Interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI. Every AI conversation contains knowledge worth keeping, but most of it gets trapped in separate chats and tools. Living Brain captures that knowledge, connects it to what you already know, and turns it into a persistent memory that keeps evolving. Share that intelligence across AI models, apps, and agents through API, SDK, or MCP, so every new interaction builds on the last instead of starting over. Reuse memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, Codex and more

title: Pushary for Teams
description_en: See who said yes to your team’s AI agents. When an AI agent stops to ask permission, Pushary sends the question to the person running it, in their Mac’s notch or on their phone. Lee’s agent asks Lee. Sam’s agent asks Sam. A rule can send a push to your infra repo to your lead instead. Answers from the phone, Mac app and dashboard are saved with a name, so when something breaks, one page shows whose agent asked and who said yes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Agy and Hermes.

title: OpusClip 4.0
description_en: Turn raw footage into ready-to-publish videos with AI. OpusClip 4.0 goes beyond AI clipping to edit raw footage into finished videos. Automatically clean up speech, add captions and B-roll, create multiple formats, apply saved editing styles, and generate animated hooks and motion graphics.

title: Maritime
description_en: Cloud computers for any AI agent, customized your way. Maritime gives AI agents their own cloud computers: persistent workspaces, disposable sandboxes, Linux and Windows desktops, and Android phones. Agents can run code, use browsers, and work in apps without APIs, with a human able to take over when needed. Whether you’re building a personal assistant or running thousands of tasks in parallel, Maritime handles the computers so you can focus on what your agent does.

title: Clocknext
description_en: Pricing and Billing Infrastructure for AI Agents. Clocknext is a billing and monetization platform for AI-native apps and agents. It’s tailored for AI founders, revenue, and engineering teams, to track AI usage from your product in real time, turn it into billable metrics with flexible pricing plans, and monitor costs, margins, and profitability at every level.

title: fileForensics
description_en: Real or not? Check files before your AI trusts them.. fileForensics is a trust check for every file your app or agent acts on. Extraction tells you what a document says; fileForensics tells you whether to believe it. It looks for signs of editing, AI-generated content, tampering and details that don’t add up, then returns findings with the evidence: what, where and why. No black-box score. All delivered in one call and works via API, MCP (Claude, Cursor, Codex), the developer portal and the fileAI platform. Check the file before you trust the data.

title: Bridge
description_en: Video conferencing for the agentic era. This launch marks a new era for Bridge: one agentic meeting platform replacing the fragmented meeting stack. Bridge now brings scheduling pages, automatic preparation, video conferencing, live intelligence, AI notetaking, agentic workflows, and structured memory into one connected experience for people and agents. At the center of this launch is a new kind of video conferencing built for customizable AI agents to join and participant in meetings.

title: KREV AI
description_en: An AI team that runs your ecommerce brand. KREV 2.0 is an AI team for your ecommerce brand. Scout tracks 10M+ competitor ads, Luna makes content that looks real, Kai buys your media, Chloe posts what's trending, Rue sends your emails, Toshi edits your store and Max gets you found.

title: Rainbrand
description_en: The brand layer for agents. Rainbrand builds and maintains shared brand context from your websites, brand guides and files. Give your agents the guidance and assets they need for marketing campaigns, websites, slides, email, video, and more. Keep that context current as your brands evolve. Use it with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Cursor, or build it into your product through the API.

title: Dessn
description_en: The design canvas that runs your real code.. When product teams ship fast with AI, it's hard to keep track of what's live and keep it consistent. Dessn runs your codebase on a design canvas, always in sync with prod, so your team and agents work from one shared source of truth. • Audit your product and find inconsistencies • Map user flows with states and personas • Comment, branch and iterate together • Share prototypes for reviews, user tests or sales demos. Connect GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket in one click. Works with every tech stack.

title: Zero Wire
description_en: Check your exposure to critical CVEs with one agent prompt . Zero Wire is a free vulnerability intelligence feed from Cloudflare Radar for security leads and engineers. Unlike CVE databases that list everything, it picks the critical issues in Internet-facing software and explains each in plain language: what's affected, who should check, and what to do now, with links to CVE records, vendor advisories and CISA KEV. Each briefing includes a ready prompt for your AI agent to run a read-only exposure check. No account needed.

title: Deployed Yet?
description_en: See if your Vercel, Cloudflare and GitHub deploys shipped. A free, open-source Mac menu bar app that answers one question: did it ship? Add as many Vercel, Cloudflare (Workers and Pages) and GitHub Actions accounts as you have, pick the projects to watch, and the menu bar shows ? while building, ✓ when it's live and ! when it broke. Get notified when a deploy fails or production goes live. Tokens stay in your Keychain and are only sent to the provider APIs.

title: Polylane for Google Cloud
description_en: An AI on-call engineer for your Google Cloud apps. Ship with confidence on Google Cloud. Polylane investigates issues in your apps, shows you what went wrong and what it affects, and prepares a fix for you to review. Get answers without digging through logs and dashboards, so you can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

title: Stitch.ai
description_en: Your AI workspace for mail, calendar, notes, tasks and more. Stitch.ai brings mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards, and files into one connected workspace. Stitchy, your AI assistant, works with you across it all. Dual workspace panels allow you to drag, drop, and Stitch anything to everything. Nothing gets lost. AI-powered Knots, Tags, and Connections keep your work organized and easy to surface. Everything is built in: no integrations or extra email clients to set up. Get your work done in one place, without losing context.

title: Hira
description_en: Your free personal agent for job search. Applying to jobs is tedious and time-consuming. Stop applying manually and let Hira, your personalized AI agent, do everything for you. You can text it, connect it to Muse, or go through our website. All for free.

title: Wingmen
description_en: Agentic outreach with real intent data. Wingmen finds people already showing they need what you sell: a post about the problem, a new hire, a job change. It scores who's worth reaching and why, writes the opener from what they actually said, and follows up on autopilot until there's a call on your calendar. Run it in the web app or straight from Claude with the Wingmen MCP. Built for founders, B2B teams and agencies.

title: Okapi
description_en: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos. AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos. It is built for developers whose apps and agents depend on third-party APIs. These APIs change all the time, and one breaking change can take your app down in production. Okapi keeps your code up to date with every API it calls, so your app keeps working and your team stops chasing changelogs. Okapi works with any API and is 100% free.

title: Tencent Hy4
description_en: Tencent’s flagship model learns to see and use a computer. Hy4 is Tencent’s latest flagship model, aimed at office tasks, financial analysis and game development. New since the preview, per Tencent: visual understanding for charts and images, and computer use across command line and graphical interfaces, with training on Blender and CAD. Tencent says the internal hallucination rate fell from 12.95% to 7.2%. Available on Tencent Cloud TokenHub, OpenRouter and Tencent apps. Weights are promised in the coming days.

title: FounderMail
description_en: Mail for you and your agents, on your Cloudflare domain. Real email on the domains you already run on Cloudflare, without paying per seat or forwarding to Gmail. You, your team and your AI agents work from the same inbox, and agents get their own access instead of your password.

title: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
description_en: Intelligent Transcription with a Speech LLM. Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open speech LLM for intelligent transcription: a single model that transcribes 40 languages verbatim or in written form, with context, speaker attribution, and word timestamps, selected with a natural language instruction. It is the best open-weights model on the English and multilingual Open ASR Leaderboards.

title: QualityLayer
description_en: Plan, build and review software with your coding agents. QualityLayer takes each code change through seven steps: Discuss, Research, Plan, Outline, Implement, Verify and Review. You comment on diagrams and clickable screens and approve the Plan before code changes. Your agent builds it test first, and a fresh agent that did not write the code checks the result against your request. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and four more on your own subscription, and runs on your computer. https://github.com/maxritter/qualitylayer

title: PasteGuard for Mac
description_en: Keep secrets and personal data out of AI chats. PasteGuard masks API keys, passwords, emails, card numbers and more on your Mac's clipboard the moment you copy, so every paste into ChatGPT, Claude, Slack or a terminal is safe. An optional Apple Intelligence check on your Mac catches what rules miss. For what only you know, add custom rules, import CSV word lists or keep an Ignore list. Restore puts the real values back. No permissions, no account, nothing leaves your Mac.

title: LiveReacting for ChatGPT
description_en: Run 24/7 and pre-recorded live streams from ChatGPT. LiveReacting is now a plugin in ChatGPT. Type @LiveReacting and ask. ChatGPT builds a looping playlist from your library and starts a 24/7 live stream, or schedules a recorded video to go live later. Stream to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, LinkedIn, X or custom RTMP at once, change the playlist while live, and check status and viewers. We run the stream, so your computer can be off. Every paid plan includes the plugin.

title: Hindsight Models and Inference API
description_en: Small, fast models for reranking, embeddings and decisions. Hosted models for the steps around your LLM: reranking, embeddings and typed decisions. Point your Cohere or OpenAI client at inference.hindsight.vectorize.io and keep your code. hs-rerank-1 and hs-embed-1 are the most accurate small open models on our benchmarks and run fast on a CPU; hs-decide-1-flash answers yes/no, pick-one and how-likely questions in 167 ms, instead of an LLM call. From $0.005 per 1M tokens, $5 free credit, open weights on Hugging Face.

title: TrackEdge
description_en: Hidden AI buttons on your MacBook’s trackpad. TrackEdge turns the edges of a MacBook trackpad into controls. Slide along the right edge for volume, the left edge for display brightness, and the bottom edge for media playback. Double-tap either top corner to mute, open an app or website, press a keyboard shortcut, or run a Shortcuts action.

title: Cosyra
description_en: Launch and steer agents on your machines from your phone. Cosyra is a mobile coding tool for iPhone and Android. Run any agent on your phone from a cloud Ubuntu terminal without managing your own VPS.

title: Hindsight Models and Inference API
description_en: Small, fast models for reranking, embeddings and decisions. Hosted models for the steps around your LLM: reranking, embeddings and typed decisions. Point your Cohere or OpenAI client at inference.hindsight.vectorize.io and keep your code. hs-rerank-1 and hs-embed-1 are the most accurate small open models on our benchmarks and run fast on a CPU; hs-decide-1-flash answers yes/no, pick-one and how-likely questions in 167 ms, instead of an LLM call. From $0.005 per 1M tokens, $5 free credit, open weights on Hugging Face.

title: AI Employees by Easy-Peasy.AI
description_en: Hire an AI team that splits the work and asks before sending. Hire AI employees by role: a Chief of Staff, analyst, designer, support rep and 15 more, or describe your own. Add your website and the team reads it. Brief everyone in a group chat: the lead splits the work, teammates reply in a thread and you get one write-up. By default, emails, calendar changes and app actions wait for your OK. Each employee has a memory, its own computer and routines that run on a schedule or when an email arrives. You can even call them. Your first employee is free.

title: Zerg Client
description_en: The coding agent harness that drives its own terminal panes. Zerg AI's own coding harness, in evaluation beta. Ask for Vim or htop and the agent opens them in panes beside it. Panes can hold more agents, each on its own model. Available models depend on your sign-in route and provider access. Mac with Apple chips.

title: Rungle
description_en: Turn your running photos and clips into share-ready Reels. Rungle is a free iPhone app that turns your runs into posts. Import distance, pace, heart rate and more from Apple Health (or a screenshot of your running app) and put them on your photos with stylish overlays. AI best cuts picks shots worth sharing, and Reel templates like KM Splits and Spider Shot come with filming guides. Running Courses helps you find your next route on a map. Keep your running app. Rungle handles the edit.

title: Hashference
description_en: Fund 45+ top AI models using your idle CPU/GPU compute. Your local GPU can't run a 400B parameter model, but its compute can pay for one. Hashference lets developers and AI agents pay for 45+ frontier models (Claude, GPT, DeepSeek) using background CPU/GPU work, Stratum mining, or HTTP 402 PoW. Powered by Quai Network.

title: Eyecon
description_en: Auto pause video when you look away. Eyecon pauses the video when you stop looking at the screen, and starts it again when you look back. Someone talks to you. You reach for something. You fall asleep. The video keeps playing, you miss a few minutes, and then you drag the progress bar around hunting for the spot where you left off. Eyecon removes that whole loop. The front camera checks one thing: whether your eyes are on the screen. When they are not, Eyecon sends a pause to whatever app is playing.

title: Fedora Linux 45
description_en: GNOME 51: Wayland fixes, oo7 keys, and modern toolchains.. Fedora Linux 45 is the latest release of the free, open-source operating system for developers, creators, and Linux enthusiasts. Enjoy GNOME 51, updated developer toolchains, stronger security defaults, and improved Wayland support. New installation capabilities include Stratis storage and browser-based remote setup for Atomic Desktops. Whether you're building software, running servers, or customizing your desktop, Fedora 45 gives you a modern Linux foundation.

title: Pinku
description_en: Private AI chat that runs offline on your iPhone and Mac. Pinku runs open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple's MLX. Download a model once and chat offline, even in airplane mode. No account, no server: your chats never leave your device. Free to start.

title: Resum
description_en:
API and SDK for live conversations. Enterprise API and SDK that connects a live conversation to named AI agents. A transcript while the session is open, then one file per agent when it ends.

title: Keel
description_en: A native macOS client for Redis, Valkey and Dragonfly. Keel is a free, open-source Mac app for Redis 6+, Valkey and Dragonfly. Browse millions of keys with SCAN only, edit every core type, use a redis-cli-style console and read server health. Read-only connections and typed confirmations keep production safe.

title: Stenograf
description_en: Private AI meeting notes that run on your computer. Stenograf records calls without a meeting bot, then transcribes, summarizes and searches them on your computer. Supported Mac and Windows. Ask questions across meetings and check the cited transcript passages. Your recordings and complete transcripts stay local.

title: MCPCore
description_en: Build and host MCP servers with no-code workflows. MCPCore lets you build MCP servers without code. Drop steps on a canvas, add loops and error branches, test live in the playground and publish a secure endpoint for Claude, Cursor, Codex and any MCP client. Or import your OpenAPI.

title: Bambu Lab H3C
description_en: Print multi-material projects faster and easier. Bambu Lab H3C is a next-generation 3D printer that makes multi-material printing faster and easier. Its nine-tool Swaptek system switches materials in as little as six seconds, with less filament waste and no repeated loading. Combine colors, rigid and flexible materials, and different nozzle sizes in a single print. With automatic calibration, integrated filament storage and drying, and support for soft TPU, H3C lets you focus on what you're making, not managing your printer.

title: ChatNest
description_en: Folders and a prompt library for your AI chats. Save AI chats into folders with a title and summary, search them live, and reuse prompt templates with variables via Ctrl+K or //. Works on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and more, in 55 languages. Local-first; Free needs no sign-in.

title: Vibeconferencing
description_en: Your Claude Code session, in your Meet, Zoom or Teams call. Vibeconferencing puts your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Grok or a local model) into your call as a participant, with a face and a voice. It hears the room, talks back, and builds on a shared whiteboard while you talk. Works in Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Slack huddles, WhatsApp, Telegram and phone calls. Free and open source.

title: Datashake MCP
description_en: Plug review and social data straight into your AI assistant. Ask your AI assistant for review and social data in plain English. "Get me last week's mentions of [brand]" comes back as clean, structured data from 10+ social networks, ready to analyse in the same chat. Try it free.

title: CC Auto Review
description_en: macOS app that reviews GitHub PRs w/ your local Claude Code. A macOS app that reviews GitHub pull requests with your local Claude Code. AI findings sit beside the diff, and you accept, reject or edit each one before posting. Every PR gets a 0–100 risk score, and an optional autopilot clears routine reviews while handing risky PRs to you with nothing posted. No clone and no API key to set up: it uses your existing gh and claude. Free and open source (MIT).

title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
description_en: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.

title: mattpocock/skills
